# go-sum-digest: go module checksums and unquoted subresource-integrity values. a digest
# authenticates content, it does not authorise access. the record names the algorithm (`h1:` is
# sha-256, `sha256-` is sri) and the value is its base64 encoding of exact length with padding.
# the quoted json and toml forms of sri are in lockfile-hash-line-shapes.txt.
example.com/widget v1.4.2 h1:{B64_44}
example.com/widget v1.4.2/go.mod h1:{B64_44}
github.com/acme/widget-core v0.0.0-20260901120000-a1b2c3d4e5f6 h1:{B64_44}
golang.org/x/text v0.21.0/go.mod h1:{B64_44}
gopkg.in/yaml.v3 v3.0.1 h1:{B64_44}
integrity: sha256-{B64_44}
    integrity: sha256-{B64_44}
hash: sha256-{B64_44}
digest: sha256-{B64_44}
checksum: sha256-{B64_44}
